Container.Name: IntroSync
Container.Overview:
Intro and credits skip markers for Plex without Plex fingerprinting every file. Once a day it looks up each episode and movie in TheIntroDB (community-verified, primary), the files' own chapter names and introdb.app (fills segment types the others lack), plans the markers, and, only when writing is switched on, writes them into Plex's database the same way MarkerEditorForPlex does (Plex has no API for intro/credits markers). Re-applies markers Plex wipes on re-analysis. Records which source every marker came from.
All run settings (sources, writing on/off, schedule, budgets, backups, API keys) live on the web UI's Settings page, stored in /data/settings.json - not in this template. The web UI also has the library browser, plan & apply, run history with undo, and submitting your own Plex detections to TheIntroDB / introdb.app. Login is optional: with it off, anything can be changed from your local network, and connections from outside it get a read-only view. Every change is also protected against other websites triggering it.
Build: docker build -t local/introsync:latest /mnt/cache/appdata/introsync Icon: node /mnt/cache/appdata/introsync/make-icon.mjs Manual stages: docker exec IntroSync node /app/tidb-sync.mjs status|sources|plan|selftest|undo log --yes --live Fingerprint detection (optional, off by default; Settings page): detects intros/credits on episodes no source covers from a few seconds of each file, via the backends' WebDAV. Uses the /mnt/debrid folder below (read-only) and the two --sysctl flags in Extra Parameters (small loopback buffers, so reads stay small). docker exec IntroSync node /app/fingerprint.mjs status Docs: /mnt/cache/appdata/introsync/README.md
Container.Requires: DUMB (Plex). Optional TheIntroDB API key in /mnt/cache/appdata/introsync/config/api_key (owner 99:100, mode 600).

Config.Name: Require login
Config.Description: Optional. false = no login; changes allowed from your local network, read-only from outside it. true = connections from outside the local network need the username and password below (HTTP Basic). /health stays open for Docker's healthcheck.

Config.Name: Also require login on the local network
Config.Description: Only matters when Require login is true. false = local network needs no login. true = everyone logs in.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Used when Require login is true.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Used when Require login is true. Stored in this template like any other setting.

Config.Name: Plex data
Config.Description: Plex's library DB (written only when APPLY_ENABLED=true) and Preferences.xml (token for the active-session check). Must be the /mnt/cache path, never /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Full Plex DB backup taken before each apply (~520 MB each). How many are kept is set by Plex DB backups to keep (KEEP_BACKUPS).

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Seeds the Plex address on the Settings page at first start; change it there afterwards.

Config.Name: Media (read-only, fingerprint detection)
Config.Description: DUMB's /mnt/debrid folder, so fingerprint detection can follow Plex's file paths to InfiniDysk / decypharr (it reads through their WebDAV, never through these mounts). Read-only.
